Title: Comment
Content: Objective Share your feedback with the team with CLO-SET Comment feature. Creating Comment Attach Images in Comment Search Comment Workroom &amp Assortment Comment Web Tech Pack Comment Permission Notification Details 1) Creating Comment 1. Create Comment: click icon from top-right corner, and start creating comments. You can tag individual user or Teams by using @ (ex. @clovirtualfashion). Maximum length is 3000 letters. *Please note that mentioning a non-member will automatically grant can View access. 2. Create Editor: You can edit the color, font, background color, or add emojis and attachments on the comment. Supported formats for attachments are: png, jpg, jpeg, pjpeg, gif, bmp. You may attach up to 25 files per Comment. Shortcut keys available on Edit Mode: Bold: Ctrl (Cmd) + B Italic: Ctrl (Cmd) + I Underline: Ctrl (Cmd) + U @Mention: @ + name Emoji : [Window + . ] OR [Ctrl+Cmd+Space Bar] 3. View All Versions: By default, you will comments on all Versions. Uncheck to only view the comments created on current Version. Attach Images to your Comment (updated Feb 2024) Drag &amp Drop Images from your local drive. Preview Images before posting. Availability to post Images only (without a text). 2) Search Comment Search the comment you're looking for. Type in the keyword, and hit enter to view the results at the bottom. 3) Workroom &amp Assortment Comment Commenting is also available at the Workroom and Assortment level. Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) 4) Web Tech Pack Comment Commenting is also available on all Web Tech Pack tabs. Comments are created/saved separate on each Tab (Overview, BOM, Construction, Measurement, and Cost Estimation). Under each Comment, you can find the version information of the uploaded file. Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) 5) Permission Space Action Admin &amp Collaborator Editor Viewer All Create O O O Workroom WTP Content Edit Group, Company Admin: O Brand Admin, Collaborator: Limited* Limited* Delete Assortment Edit Admin: O Collaborator: Limited* Delete All Mention others O O X *Can only Edit/Delete comments created by oneself, cannot modify comments created by other users. **Permission varies on Space Level. To start using Comment features, user must have permission to the applicable Space/Content. For example, if a user holds Content Editor permission, they can create new Comment on that Content, but may not be able to create Workroom Content. 6) Notification When a Comment is created/edited/deleted, notification will be sent to all users with permission to the Workroom/Assortment/Content. To stop receiving notifications, end users can turn off notification settings on specific Space or Content by unchecking the 'bell' button. Notification of new Comments will be displayed on the Notifications tab. Email Notification may be sent based on the end user's notification settings on 'My Page'. <table style="border-collapse: collapse width: 86.2857%">

Title: Content Information Fields
Content: Objective Learn about Content Information Fields in CLO-SET and how to effectively utilize the feature. What is Content Information Field? Field Management Default Fields Custom Fields *Number Type Fields Input/View Content Information Permission Detail 1) What is Content Information Field? The Content Field is where information about the Content is stored. Users can customize the fields used for each Content Type. Start storing Content information in CLO-SET to elevate your asset management flow. Content Fields are tailored for each Content Type. Fields used can only be managed by Company Admin and Group Operator. To start adding custom fields, read the instructions below. 2) Field Management Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin Before inputting information on the Content, we recommend that you review the fields used for each Content Type. To add/edit Content Fields for each Content Type, visit Company Settings. Click on 'Content' &gt 'Information' to view the list of Content Types and Fields used. Content Fields are shared and applied to all Contents within the Company. 1. Default Fields Default Fields can NOT be added or deleted. You can change the name, values, and unit format. CLO-SET Provides tailored Defaults Fields for each Content Type. For example, for Style type Contents, there are 6 Default Fields - material composition, customer type, color, price, MOQ, and date. To edit the name, value, or unit format, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. On the Edit modal, edit the details and click 'Save'. 2. Custom Fields Custom Fields are fully customizable. Can create up to 16 Custom Fields per Content Type. To add a Custom Field, start by clicking the 'Add Custom Field' button. Fill in the name and select the 'Type' of the field to be used. Fill in values or unit information when applicable, and click 'Save' to create the Custom Field. Field Types provided are listed below. Once the field is saved, field type CANNOT be changed. Text (up to 100 characters) Textbox (up to 1000 characters) Number (in unit format) Date (in calendar format) Dropdown: single-selection Checkbox: multi-selection allowed To edit the Custom Field, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. Changing the field details will impact the existing field information. To delete the Custom Field, hover over the field row and click the trash button. Deleting the field will impact the existing field information, and the data stored will no longer be available. 3. 'Number' Type Fields Unit Options Currency Options for Price Unit Format Example When editing the 'Number' type fields, you have an option to customize the unit format. Please refer to the table below for placeholders used to customize the unit format. Placeholder Explanation 0 The number of digits. Insignificant zeros are displayed in the result # The number of digits. Meaningless zeros will not appear in the result . (decimal point) Format numbers with decimal separators , (rest) Specifies a thousands separator in a number 3) Input/View Content Information Permission: All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit field information / Viewers are read only Go to Content Page, and click the 'Expand' button on the left pane. Once the Content Field section is open, click on the field to begin entering the information. Any information added or edited will be saved immediately as entered. Exiting the Content Field tab will NOT undo the changes. 4) Permission Field Management: by Group Admin or Company Admin at Company Settings page Input/View Content Information: All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit field information. Viewers are read only

Title: Web Tech Pack (WTP)
Content: Permission: Admin Collaborator Editor Objective CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. What is Web Tech Pack (WTP)? Requirements &amp Access WTP Tabs &amp Data Overview BOM Construction Measurement Cost Estimtaion WTP Version Update WTP Comment Details 1) What is 'Web Tech Pack (WTP)'? Web Tech Pack is an auto-generated Tech Pack based on your 3D file. Manage production details such as BOM / POM / Cost information, always up-to-date for the whole team. 2) Requirements &amp Access Content Type: for a WTP to be created, the Content Type must be 'Style' Learn more on Content Type &amp ID here. Access the Tech Pack page by clicking the button from Content page You must be Admin / Collaborator / Editor to view the Web Tech Pack *zpac/zprj files are auto-identified as Style Type upon upload 3) WTP Tabs &amp Data WTP Tabs Overview View the summary of the Content and manage Schedule. BOM Auto-generated BOM per colorway and grade. Construction Mark detailed annotation per Fabric, Pattern, Graphic, etc. Measurement POM information including 2D &amp target measurement for production. Cost Estimation Cost Estimation including Fabric, Trim, Labor, Transportation, etc. WTP data synchronization with Content Page Changes on below from WTP will be reflected on Content page (vice versa). Content Name Company / Brand / Season / Line / Workroom Workflow Creator/Created Date Thumbnail Tags Description 4) WTP Version Update When you upload a new version of the Style file(.Zpac, .Zprj), you have an option to update the WTP New WTP information will be reflected on BOM / Construction / Measurement / Cost Estimation tab Once you click 'UPDATE', the Style information in Web Tech Pack will be updated If you accidentally press the 'CANCEL' button, you must re-upload the same file. 5) Web Tech Pack Comment Commenting is also available on all tabs. Comments are created/saved separate on each Tab (Overview, BOM, Construction, Measurement, and Cost Estimation). Under each Comment, you can find the version information of the uploaded file. Please follow the hyperlink to find permissions details

Title: Configurator
Content: Permission: Admin Collaborator Editor Supported File Type: zpac, zprj, zfab Objective Try CLO-SET Configurator to explore design options online. Instantly review different color, texture, and property options with your team. Configurator: How-to Color Editor Color Preset Texture Editor Property Editor Downloading the New Colorway Create New Version Best Practice Workflow Details 1) Configurator: How-to Click on the (Configurator) button from Content page. Select an item to edit from the Material List Select a new option from Color/Texture/Property tab, and click 'Create' New Colorway has been added under the 'Colorway' tab. Colorways created with CLO-SET Configurator will have the icon. Hover over the new Colorway on the right-pane to delete. 2) Color Editor Pick a Color from palette to apply on your design Reset the color by 'Reset color' button at the bottom Click 'Create' to save the new colorway Upload a Color Preset to be shared with your team. Picker PANTONE coloro CUSTOM 3) Texture Editor Upload a Texture image Adjust the texture using: Gizmo on the style Position/Scale/Rotation button on Configurator Use Desaturation option Reset Texture or Create new colorway 4) Property Editor Edit the Property of the file - Opacity, Roughness, Intensity, or Metalness Click 'Reset Property' to reset it to match the original file Click 'Create' to create a new colorway 5) Downloading the New Colorway Select 'All Colorways' option to download a new .ZPRJ file including both the 1) Colorway from your original content, and 2) new Colorways created with configurator () Choose the version you wish to download. Hover over the version tab &gt click on &gt select 'All Colorways' 'Original Content' option will only include colorways from your original zprj file Upload the new zprj file to use: Render, Web Tech Pack, Line Sheet, Embed/Fitting 6) Create New Version Creating a new Version will help make the New Colorway(created with Configurator) compatible with all CLO-SET features. Save: Save the work before creating a new Colorway. Once saved, you can exit out of the Configurator tool and use other 3D viewer options (exploded view, schematic render, etc.) for review. Add Colorway: Create a new Colorway to be added on your Colorway list on the right pane. Colorways made with Configurator will have the icon. Create New Version: Create a new Version including the new Colorways made with Configurator. Creating a new Version will help make the New Colorway compatible with all CLO-SET features. *Please note: for ZFAB files, you may only create a new version. Adding a new Colorway to the original file is unavailable. 7) Best Practice Workflow 3D Garment: Create new Colorways with Configurator, and create new Version to create production materials such as Render and Tech Pack. Block Pattern: Start from a block pattern to create new Colorways for a new season. ZFAB: create new patterns or color options for an existing ZFAB file in CLO-SET.

Title: Trigger
Content: Objective You can set the triggers and sync URL at Trigger menu. Location Steps Set Sync Set Render Trigger Set Webhook Details 1) Location Group Console Developer page Trigger Choose a company to set trigger 2) Steps [Set sync] 1. Enter the URL and click 'Update' button. 2. Go to style page. You can see the sync button activated. 3. Click sync button to open new tab with the URL you entered above. The new tab's URL contains Style ID, style version, external style ID as query string. [Set Render trigger] 1. Click 'ADD TRIGGER' under Render section. 2. Choose workflow status that fires the trigger. 3. Go to Workroom or Style page and change Workflow of style. 4. Render is then requested. To see in on the page, you need to refresh. *Render will be requested with the uploaded file's render properties set in CLO S/W. [Set Webhook] 1. Click 'Add trigger' under webhook section. 2. Choose Workflow status that you want to fire the trigger. 3. Enter the URL that webhook will be requested. 4. Enter the Name and Value if you want to check whether the request is valid. It will be added in HTTP header with webhook request. 5. Go to Workroom or Style page and change workflow of style. 6. Webhook firing will be requested soon. Webhook request body sample { "UpdateTime": "2020-07-21T06:25:09.759785Z", "UpdateUser": "hello@clo-set.com", "Topic": { "TopicId": "4ea0710a0e5f4e099d92f7a284d167f9", "Version": 1, "TopicType": 1 }, "TriggerType": 1, "TriggerOption": { "WorkflowSeq": 1679, "TriggerStatus": 1 } } Webhook body schema { "UpdateTime": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateTime", "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "description": "The update time that trigger fired." }, "UpdateUser": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateUser", "type": "string", "description": "Email address of user" }, "Topic": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic", "type": "object", "description": "The updated space/style information", "required": [ "TopicId", "Version", "TopicType" ], "properties": { "TopicId": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicId", "type": "string", "description": "The id of updated style or space" }, "Version": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/Version", "type": "integer", "description": "Version of style. Will be '0' if topic type is not style.", "default": 0 }, "TopicType": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "Enum for what the topic type is. 0 is none, 1 is style.", "default": "None" } } }, "TriggerType": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The trigger type that webhook triggered. 0 is none, 1 is workflow", "default": 0 }, "TriggerOption": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption", "type": "object", "description": "The object information for trigger", "required": [ "WorkflowSeq", "TriggerStatus" ], "properties": { "WorkflowSeq": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/WorkflowSeq", "type": "integer", "description": "Workflow seq that tiggered." }, "TriggerStatus": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/TriggerStatus", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The changed trigger status for triggered object. 0 is none, 1 is changed", "default": 0 } } } }

Title: Virtual Fitting - Troubleshooting (Technical Specifications)
Content: Objective Learn about the technical specifications and troubleshooting guide for Virtual Fitting. *For basic requirements to use Virtual Fitting, please refer to the Fitting article HERE. Requirements Particle Distance Texture Hardware Fitting Error - Troubleshooting Details 1) Requirements Before we start the troubleshooting process, please make sure your file meets all Fitting Conversion requirements listed below. File Format .zprj, .zpac CLO Software ver7.1 or higher Avatar CLO avatars must be v2 and above (simulated on A pose) Custom Avatar option requirements can be found HERE 3D Project File 3D garment must be dressed on an avatar before saving a file 2) Particle Distance Minimum Particle Distance value is 20 for CLO-SET Fitting Conversion. This is to ensure the stability and speed of the task for all CLO-SET users. CLO-SET will automatically increase the particle distance to 20 for any patterns with lower than 20 particle distance value. Fitting Conversion time is shorter for files with smaller size, and higher particle distance in general. 3) Texture All Textures should be in low resolution between 20 - 72 DPI. We recommend NOT using Normal Map. Using Normal Map will increase the file size, which slows down the Fitting Conversion process. For creating Texture images and adjusting resolution, please refer to this video from CLO3D. 4) Hardware Remove unnecessary hardware from your garment, as the hardware may conflict with the simulation of different grading options. If the hardware presence is critical, we recommend adding them as a graphic texture. 5) Fitting Error - Troubleshooting If you are experiencing Fitting error, please refer to the troubleshooting guide listed below. Please note that this list may not cover all cases. For further support, please create a ticket HERE. Please check if your file has any of the below issues when simulating in CLO3D. Make sure to check all of the grading options by clicking on each option. 1. Points are too close together. Please move or delete a point. The minimum distance between points is 0.5mm. If the points in your file are too close, please delete a point or move the point. 2. Lines or points are too close together. If the internal lines or grading lines are too close together, you may see the below error message. In this case, please delete the line or change the grading details to resolve the issue. If you have opened an external CAD file, you may not be able to open the grading in CLO. In this case, please use the original tool used to create the CAD file, and fix the issue from there. 3. Holes cannot overlap. Make sure the holes on your pattern do not overlap on all of the Grading options. Please edit Grading or the size of the hole to solve the issue. 4) Holes must be placed within a Pattern. Holes on your pattern must be placed within the pattern on all Grading options. Please edit Grading or hole placement to solve the issue. 5) Pattern outlines and/or holes are intersecting. Holes cannot overlap with the pattern outline. Please move or edit the hole size to solve the issue. 6) Please click within a Pattern. Graphics must be placed within the pattern on all Grading options. Please edit the graphic size or placement to solve the issue. 7) Invalid boundary points. Please double-check the Grading information on your file. Below is an example of a file with error in Grading information. Please fix it on all sizes and try again.

Title: Copy Space Structure
Content: Permission: may vary per scenario. Please see below. Plan Type: ALL (Enterprise, Advanced, Free, Trial) Objective With this feature, you can easily replicate the Space Structure to prepare for a new season. Copy Space Structure Copy Company Copy Brand Copy Line/Season Additional Notes Details 1) Copy Space Structure Simply copy any Space from Company to Season along with sub-level Spaces up to the 1st-depth Workroom. Only the Space Hierarchy will be copied, NOT including the Contents within the original Space. Basics: Go to 'Browse' menu or 'Workspace' to find the Space you want to Copy On the upper-right corner of the Space, click then click 'Copy Space Structure' Insert the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' Only the Space Structure will be copied without Contents, Categories, and Workflows 2) Copy Company Structure Permission: Group Admin only Go to Workspace &gt Companies to select the Company to Copy Click on on the upper-right corner of the Company &gt click 'Copy Space Structure' Type in the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Company Space. You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu The new Company Space will replicate all Company Settings of the original Company. 3) Copy Brand Structure Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin Option 1: Go to 'Browse' &gt and select the Company within which the Brand is located Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' &gt Brands Click on on the upper-right corner of the Brand &gt click 'Copy Space Structure' Type in the name of the new Brand, and select where you want the new Brand to be You may only choose between Company Spaces you have permission to Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Brand Space. You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu 4) Copy Line/Season Structure Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin, Company Collaborator, Brand Admin Option 1: Go to 'Browse' &gt and select the Brand within which the Line/Season is located Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' &gt Lines/Seasons Click on on the upper-right corner of the Line/Season &gt click 'Copy Space Structure' Type in the name of the new Space, and select where you want the new Line/Season to be You may only choose between Brand Spaces you have permission to Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Space. You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu 5) Additional Notes Please mind that the Copy Space Structure: only copies the Space Hierarchy, NOT the Contents within copying the Space between Groups is unavailable copying Workroom/Assortment level Spaces is unavailable
